name: barq
description: Fast browser hands for coding agents: name an outcome, and Jev (TypeSafe's decision model) picks each click in about 300 ms. Works in a browser it launches or in your own Chrome or Edge, with your logins, and keeps passwords out of the chat.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Your key from console.typesafe.ai. Leave empty to use the macOS keychain item "typesafe-api-key" or TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

browser.title: Work in your own browser
browser.description: launch: start a separate Chromium. own: a browser barq keeps to itself, which never asks to be allowed (sign in inside it once). Or name a running browser to work inside it, with your logins: chrome, edge, brave, chromium, vivaldi, arc, or auto (the first one found). Those need remote debugging allowed once (chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging).

placement.title: Where the agent's tabs go in your browser
placement.description: auto: a tab group if the helper extension is loaded, otherwise a separate window. group, window or tab to force one.
